view_health_contract.name: View health contract
view_health_contract.description: Read the health contract declared for one selected Hubinet Ops resource. No contract means unconfigured, never healthy.

device_id.name: Resource
device_id.description: Select a workload resource managed by Hubinet Ops.

set_health_contract.name: Set health contract
set_health_contract.description: Replace the complete health contract for one selected Hubinet Ops resource. Every declared probe is required.

device_id.name: Resource
device_id.description: Select a workload resource managed by Hubinet Ops.

probes.name: Probes
probes.description: The complete list of required probes, each with a kind (systemd_unit_active, docker_container_running, or docker_container_healthy) and a target name.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Optional. Refuse the change unless the stored contract is still at this revision; use 0 to require no contract yet.

clear_health_contract.name: Clear health contract
clear_health_contract.description: Remove the health contract for one selected Hubinet Ops resource. The resource becomes unconfigured, which is not healthy.

device_id.name: Resource
device_id.description: Select a workload resource managed by Hubinet Ops.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Optional. Refuse the change unless the stored contract is still at this revision.

start_update.name: Start update
start_update.description: Explicitly start the currently approved package update for one selected Hubinet Ops resource. This is the only way a real package change ever begins; Hubinet Ops never starts one on its own.

device_id.name: Resource
device_id.description: Select a workload resource managed by Hubinet Ops.

view_update_job.name: View update job
view_update_job.description: Read the current or latest package update job for one selected Hubinet Ops resource, with a bounded tail of its events.

device_id.name: Resource
device_id.description: Select a workload resource managed by Hubinet Ops.

events.name: Events
events.description: How many recent job events to return (0-200).

resume_update.name: Resume update
resume_update.description: Ask Hubinet Ops to re-enter an existing recoverable update job after a transient uncertainty. It never resubmits a package change; it re-reads the durable checkpoint and continues only where that is safe.

device_id.name: Resource
device_id.description: Select a workload resource managed by Hubinet Ops.

rollback_update.name: Roll back update
rollback_update.description: Explicitly roll one resource back to the snapshot its own update job created. Hubinet Ops never rolls back on its own, and never to any other snapshot. A successful rollback leaves the guest stopped.

device_id.name: Resource
device_id.description: Select a workload resource managed by Hubinet Ops.
